leakage_policy.unit: Connected issuer/entity/history group; all versions, reports, subsidiaries in the relevant corporate group, reprints and translations stay together.
leakage_policy.support_entities: All answer-bearing comparison entities belong to the same split; primary-entity-only disjointness is insufficient. Do not connect incidental mentions into a universal graph.
leakage_policy.old_exposure: Exclude the union of all prior source registers, discovery candidates, source streams, Plug/OPERA/JAMA and benchmark/public examples read by any project role from a fresh test. Metadata-only old pools already declared development remain development.
leakage_policy.metadata_lookup_exposure: Dataset pages automatically displayed public QA previews. AAL and all visible Multi-Doc preview entities are exposed development material; complete the preview-ID/entity ledger before any split.
leakage_policy.public_pretraining_limit: Unseen to project evaluation is not unseen to pretraining; public dataset contamination cannot be ruled out.
leakage_policy.template_check: Group byte/near duplicates and report issuer/template-family overlap. Add a family-held-out secondary test before claiming cross-template generalization.
leakage_policy.test_access: Build entity split from source metadata before test source-body/question/reference authoring; sealed test references unavailable to method development roles.

sampling.pilot_frame: Pinned Multi-Doc source HTML inventory only, stripped of questions/answers; fixed fiscal-year window 2022-2024.
sampling.eligible_metadata: At least two consecutive annual-report years for a canonical issuer, with independently resolvable source URL and identity. No correction, outcome, difficulty or model-score quota.
sampling.ordering: Sort eligible canonical issuer IDs by SHA256(seed || issuer_id). For each issuer sort its consecutive report pairs by SHA256(seed || issuer_id || earlier_report_id || later_report_id); select first pair. Keep full eligible/excluded ledger.
sampling.pilot_size: First 8 eligible previously unexposed issuer groups; at most 16 source representations, two retrieval attempts per URL. These become development only.
sampling.failure_policy: No silent substitutions. Record failures against attempted denominator. Any reserve sequence must be frozen in the same initial manifest, never chosen after labels/outputs. Stop acquisition at declared cap.
sampling.secondary_frame_proposal: If the pilot works, enumerate an independently pinned official SEC 10-K metadata frame for fiscal years 2022-2024, excluding all exposed groups. Broader frame is a new prospective acquisition stage, not an on-the-fly replacement for pilot failures.

confirmatory_target.note: Planning minimum/target, not acquired counts or power guarantee. Source/question shortfalls remain visible; do not manufacture four questions per group.

sampling.split_assignment: Sort unexposed canonical groups by SHA256(seed + '|split|' + group_id); first 12 development, next 8 validation, next 40 test. Assign whole connected groups before reading held-out questions/answers. Never split adjacent reports or multi-entity question support across partitions.
sampling.cross_company_policy: Primary lane is same-issuer adjacent-report comparison. Optional cross-company lane uses components of all participating entities; omit cross-split QA with ledger or assign whole components, without using answers to choose.

admission.transport: Log attempted URL, redirect, response status/type, retrieved bytes and hash. A successful response/title alone is insufficient.
admission.source_identity: Verify issuer, reporting period, document/form/accession or publisher identifier from source; retain source authority separate from transport host.
admission.representation: Retain complete original HTML/PDF and source-faithful text/layout extraction with recipe and hashes. Audit exact source spans; local extraction gaps are explicit.
admission.history_relation: Label successive-report, explicit correction, reanalysis/changed definition, same-period comparative, retained result, or unresolved from sources. No requirement for a nondirect dependent; no correction label from recency alone.
admission.historical_clock: Observed exact-version/source comparison does not require certified first-public availability. Record filing/version dates separately; no historical replay claim without independent clock evidence.
admission.release: Keep dataset/code/source licenses separate; distribute URLs/hashes/locators/retrieval code when source redistribution basis is unresolved.
admission.eligibility_unknowns: Do not force equality/comparability of different metrics/populations. Keep unanswerable/irreducibly ambiguous cases instead of treating source gaps as false facts.
admission.no_quota: No minimum positive-correction or method-friendly ambiguity quota for admission.

question_tracks.natural_source_primary: Unmodified source documents. Sample pre-existing question IDs only after source selection and entity splitting, preserving published wording/provenance. Source-authored analyst-style questions are a separately tagged cohort, not naturally occurring user queries.
question_tracks.question_sampling: Within each source group use deterministic hash order of eligible IDs; reviewers apply only frozen relevance/answerability/task-type rules, not expected method performance. No forced two-document requirement; later report alone may be sufficient.
question_tracks.source_authored_extension: If exact comparison questions are missing, two source reviewers may author up to 4 concise questions from fixed sections Item 7/Item 8 and explicit report cross-references. Enumerate all candidates before hash selection. Ask reported values/scopes or warranted comparison, not an invented downstream dependency.
question_tracks.arithmetic_boundary: Primary route reports stated quantities and relations without recomputing values. Existing questions requiring new arithmetic remain in a separately declared calculator-enabled secondary cohort; no quiet prompt/reference relaxation.
question_tracks.authored_attachment_stress: Separate clearly labeled paired stress set of unit/header/period/continuation/footnote swaps or evidence withholding. Balance length, lexical overlap, entity/year mentions and numbers; randomize order. Preserve originals; annotate intervention and expected answerability. Never merge stress accuracy with natural-source results.
question_tracks.controls: Include unambiguous, unchanged, changed-scope, answerable-from-later-only and naturally unresolved cases at observed rates; publish prevalence, not a handpicked hard-only denominator.

annotation.source_truth: Annotate source assertions and comparison relation before model predictions using full source pages/objects; independent review checks exact spans and source identity.
annotation.evidence: Physical page+character/line spans for PDFs; immutable HTML/object offsets/DOM coordinates for HTML. Include rendered checks for multiline headers/merged cells. All relevant units and exceptions need witnesses; page IDs alone are insufficient.
annotation.human_status: Two genuinely independent source-aware reviewers are proposed for final test references, with disagreements adjudicated before predictions. Current model-assisted shared-session roles can prepare provisional annotations but do not satisfy an independent-human-gold claim. Resources are unresolved.
missingness: reader error despite complete received support
annotation.labels: supported/contradicted/unresolved per claim or binding; absence is never contradiction. Correct partial answer and appropriate abstention are distinct from unsupported assertion. Missing output format is not automatically semantic error.
annotation.reference_leakage: No gold scope/binding/witness or reference sufficient-page list enters inference. Oracle contexts and hypotheses are diagnostic ceilings only.

candidate_binding_evaluation.candidate_pool: Same frozen hybrid source pool and structural neighbors for objective-isolation comparisons; primary whole-pipeline comparisons also report independently retrieved pools.
candidate_binding_evaluation.correct_binding_recall: Fraction of source-answerable questions for which at least one fully valid scoped interpretation survives automatic proposal/pruning; report before retrieval selection and after each verifier step.
candidate_binding_evaluation.material_alternative_recall: Recall of independently annotated plausible answer-changing alternatives; report per history and ambiguity type, with uncertainty for incomplete annotation.
candidate_binding_evaluation.false_elimination: Count source-valid bindings rejected as contradicted, not merely left unresolved; report rate and causes.
candidate_binding_evaluation.unknown_state: Truncated proposal beam retains an explicit unmodeled/unknown flag. Single survivor without positive source support is not success.
candidate_binding_evaluation.cost: Charge proposal generation, pair checking, verifier inputs/outputs, retries and corpus preprocessing; no oracle metadata is free.

resource_protocol.same_reader: Pin a competent reader, template, quantization, tokenizer and decoding using development controls before test. Same reader/abstention policy across methods.
resource_protocol.caps_not_padding: Every method gets the same ceilings and can spend unused calls on generic reranking/querying. Do not pad cheap baselines to fake equal cost; report actual source/input/output tokens, calls, latency and memory.
resource_protocol.count_everything: Charge instructions, document/page labels, copied headers/units, candidate-hypothesis text, all controller/verifier calls and failed retries. Report offline parsing/indexing separately.
resource_protocol.packing: Union overlapping exact spans; whole dependency bundles only; deterministic skip-overbudget; no answer-aware backfill. Header words are not invisible metadata.
resource_protocol.curves: After a separate resource feasibility check, freeze full-input curves 1800/3500/7000 with compatible model context. Include larger-context parent baseline; do not present a tight-budget-only win as general dominance.
resource_protocol.strong_reader_gate_proposal: At least 90% jointly grounded, scope-correct answers on 32 independently checked complete-source development cases, with no more than 1 critical unit/sign/year/population error. Practical entry gate, not reader certification.

metrics.primary: Fully source-grounded and scope-correct answer coverage on source-answerable natural-source questions, with exact/accepted numerical tolerance and claim-level citation support.
metrics.co_primary_safety: Unsupported comparison-claim rate at matched answer coverage; report risk-coverage curves with thresholds fixed on validation.
separate: Claim-level citation support in actual received context
Source versus representation versus retrieval completeness
metrics.uncertainty: Paired comparison within questions; confidence intervals/bootstrap clustered by entity-history group, not independent question count. Pin analysis and baseline selection on validation before test.

scalability.candidate_complexity: Naive M*K*(K-1)/2 source checks at M64/K8 equals 1792 bundle-pair candidates, not a feasible assumption of 1792 free LLM calls. Use factorized/cached source-conditioned judgments under the 4-call cap.
scalability.proposal_pruning: Report lost correct/alternative bindings, unknown flags and coverage as K changes; no oracle pruning.
scalability.distractor_sampling: Fixed metadata-sampled same-year/industry and unrelated filings, without gold-answer dependence; same distractors per method.
report: Evidence recall and support at each corpus size
scalability.limits: No whole-corpus materialization or scaling run performed. Larger counts require separately authorized/resource-feasible acquisition; no claimed asymptotic theorem for heuristic selection.

go_no_go_proposals.status: Numerical planning thresholds to freeze only after feasibility/power review, before new test outcomes. They are not achieved results, guarantees or ACL acceptance criteria.
go_no_go_proposals.pilot_data: After 8 attempted new groups, at least 6 source-identity/representation-admissible pairs, with all failures logged. Otherwise pause data expansion and repair access/provenance; do not weaken criteria or silently replace pairs.
go_no_go_proposals.residual_prevalence: Source-only audit of at least 24 natural-source questions across at least 6 groups should find at least 6 genuinely resolvable answer-changing binding ambiguities across at least 4 groups. If not, do not build a specialized selector; report conventional baseline/data finding. This is an investment criterion, not a quota for retaining hard cases.
go_no_go_proposals.reference_reliability: Before test, at least 90% independent agreement on required scope/support and adjudication of all material disagreements; absent independent reviewers, release provisional model-assisted evaluation with limited claims.
go_no_go_proposals.candidate_gate: On validation, correct scoped-binding recall at least 95% and material-alternative recall at least 85%; false valid-binding elimination no more than 2%. If missed, repair proposal/verifier before testing selector gain.
go_no_go_proposals.confirmatory_size: At least 40 untouched test entity-history groups and 160 eligible questions proposed. If source/question yield is smaller, run a descriptive pilot, not a confirmatory superiority claim. Reassess power from development cluster variation before freezing final N.
go_no_go_proposals.method_gain: At least 5 percentage points more fully grounded answer coverage than the validation-selected strongest generic baseline at the primary matched ceilings, with history-clustered 95% interval for improvement above 0; unsupported comparison risk must not worsen and claimed risk reduction must persist at matched coverage.
go_no_go_proposals.robustness: Direction should persist with a second competent reader and a larger-context parent baseline; report every planned comparison. No gain claims based solely on authored stress, one issuer/template, oracle bindings or uncharged extra calls.
go_no_go_proposals.stop: Stop distinct algorithmic claim if generic structure/gap/interpretation baseline matches P, candidate/verifier errors negate gain, natural ambiguity is too rare, metadata/extraction remains unreliable, or closest prior work already implements the same mechanism. Recast as reproducibility/resource/failure-analysis result where warranted.
